body.x: Seven Dreamers have been announced that the will be showcasing the world’s first fully automatic laundry folding bot — the “laundroid”— at CES 2017.The company has announced that they will be doing a live demonstration of the product during CES 2017, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 8th.The laundroid combines image analysis, artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring the world’s fully automatic, laundry folding and sorting bot. Laundroid aims to tackle three objectives with one product— time, space and habits. Time, by reducing the amount of time spent on actually doing the laundry and providing the users with more leisure time; Space, by tidying up the messy rooms and storage space with neatly folded clothes; and habits, where users would be more inclined to actually put away the laundry with pre-folded clothes and ultimately consuming less machines, with its constant software update features.The laundroid can be operated by a matching smartphone app or itself.The company is currently taking a worldwide preorder request starting from March 2017 from their website.Seven Dreamers Laboratory is located in Tokyo, Japan, founded in 2011. They aim to be ’the technologists creating what the world has never seen’. Aside from the laundroid, the company also focuses on healthcare and carbon shaft business.
